exams.name: Oregon Board of Optometry Examination
exams.notes: Covers anatomy of the eye, pharmaceutical agents, refractive and accommodative conditions, subjective and objective optometry, lens fitting, lens grinding, and frame adjusting.
exams.quote: Any person who has signified to the Oregon Board of Optometry a desire to be examined by it and who has filed proof that the person is qualified under ORS 683.010 to 683.340 and the rules of the board to take the examination shall pay a fee to be determined by the board.

exams.name: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
exams.notes: The board may, in its discretion, require the NBEO certificate in lieu of its own examination in certain areas.
exams.quote: The board may, in its discretion, require the certificate of successful examination of the National Board of Examiners in Optometry in one or more areas of the examination in lieu of its examination in such areas.

required.quote: All optometrists licensed in the State of Oregon are and shall be required to satisfactorily complete courses of study and satisfactorily continue their education by other means as determined by the Oregon Board of Optometry

period_years.quote: shall be submitted by each optometrist at the time designated by the board but in any case no less frequently than once every two years

available.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry may grant to an applicant a license by endorsement for the practice of optometry in the State of Oregon

requirements.value: Must hold a license by examination in another state, have continuously practiced for at least 2 years, meet equivalent educational qualifications (including NBEO or equivalent), meet TPA certification requirements, pass Oregon optometric law exam, submit CE documentation, and pay application fee.
requirements.quote: Holds a license for the practice of optometry obtained by examination in another state of the United States... Continuously engaged in the practice of optometry for not less than two years immediately preceding the application

exists.quote: The Oregon Board of Optometry operates as a semi-independent state agency subject to ORS 182.456 to 182.472, for the purpose of carrying out this chapter. The board consists of five members appointed by the Governor

national_certification.value: National Board of Examiners in Optometry (NBEO)
national_certification.quote: The educational requirements shall include passing the National Board of Examiners in Optometry examination or its equivalent, as determined by the board

regulatory_model.quote: a person may not engage in the practice of optometry or purport in any way to be an optometrist or an expert in the field of optometry without having first obtained a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry

credential_type.quote: without having first obtained a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry as provided for in ORS 683.010 to 683.340

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not engage in the practice of optometry or purport in any way to be an optometrist or an expert in the field of optometry without having first obtained a license from the Oregon Board of Optometry

title_protection.quote: Advertise or represent, by displaying a sign or otherwise, to be an optometrist without having at the time of so doing a valid unrevoked license from the board.

scope_protection.quote: Practice optometry in this state without having at the time of so doing a valid unrevoked license as an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor with demonstrable relationship to optometric duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor where such an offense bears a demonstrable relationship to the duties of an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Securing a license by practicing fraud or deceit upon the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Securing a license by practicing fraud or deceit upon the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct, or gross ignorance or inefficiency in the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct, or for gross ignorance or inefficiency in the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining any fee by fraud or misrepresentation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing directly or indirectly any suspended or unlicensed optometrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing directly or indirectly any suspended or unlicensed optometrist to perform any work covered by ORS 683.010 to 683.340.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising optometric services using untruthful, improbable, misleading or deceitful statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising optometric services or treatment or advice in which untruthful, improbable, misleading or deceitful statements are made.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitting another person to use the optometrist's license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Permitting another person to use the optometrist's license.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising optometric services without having a licensed optometrist at the location
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using advertisements that do not indicate that a licensed optometrist is practicing at the advertised location or locations or advertising optometric services without having a licensed optometrist at the location or locations.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising professional methods or professional superiority
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising professional methods or professional superiority.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with continuing education requirements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with the requirements for continuing education.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the federal Controlled Substances Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the federal Controlled Substances Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing controlled substances without legitimate optometric purpose or without proper examination/record-keeping
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing controlled substances without a legitimate optometric purpose, or without following accepted procedures for examination of patients or for record keeping.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report adverse action taken by another licensing jurisdiction or regulatory body
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report to the board any adverse action taken against the optometrist or person by another licensing jurisdiction, health regulatory board, peer review body, health care institution, professional optometric society or association, governmental agency, law enforcement agency or court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been disciplined by a health regulatory board of another state for similar acts
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been disciplined by any health regulatory board of another state based on acts similar to acts described in this section.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of the provisions of ORS 683.010 to 683.340
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the provisions of ORS 683.010 to 683.340.

definition_quote.value: A dispensing optician is a person who prepares and dispenses lenses, eyeglasses and appurtenances thereto to the intended wearers thereof on written prescriptions from a physician licensed under ORS chapter 677 or an optometrist and, in accordance with such prescriptions, measures, adapts, adjusts and fabricates such lenses, eyeglasses and appurtenances for the aid or correction of visual or ocular anomalies of the human eye.
definition_quote.quote: "dispensing optician" means a person who prepares and dispenses lenses, eyeglasses and appurtenances thereto to the intended wearers thereof on written prescriptions from a physician licensed under ORS chapter 677 or an optometrist and, in accordance with such prescriptions, measures, adapts, adjusts and fabricates such lenses, eyeglasses and appurtenances for the aid or correction of visual or ocular anomalies of the human eye.

value: duplicate ophthalmic lenses (excluding contact lenses) when presented with whole lens
methods_authorized.quote: Any dispensing optician may fabricate any ophthalmic lens in conformity with the signed prescription, or oral instruction followed by a written prescription, of any optometrist or person duly licensed to practice medicine in this state. Any dispensing optician may supply any ophthalmic lens in conformity with the prescription and the specified expiration date thereof.

contact_lens_scope_included.quote: a dispensing optician may accept or offer to accept for purposes of duplication any ophthalmic lens, excluding any contact lens, when the optician is presented with a whole lens

duplicate_without_prescription_allowed.quote: a dispensing optician may accept or offer to accept for purposes of duplication any ophthalmic lens, excluding any contact lens, when the optician is presented with a whole lens by the person requesting the duplicate lens.

written_prescription_required.quote: Any dispensing optician may fabricate any ophthalmic lens in conformity with the signed prescription, or oral instruction followed by a written prescription, of any optometrist or person duly licensed to practice medicine in this state.

prescription_expiration_enforced.quote: Any dispensing optician may supply any ophthalmic lens in conformity with the prescription and the specified expiration date thereof.

ready_made_nonprescription_eyewear_exemp.quote: To prohibit the sale of complete ready-to-wear eye glasses as merchandise from a permanent place of business in good faith and not in evasion of ORS 683.010 to 683.340 by any person not purporting to be competent to examine and prescribe for the human eye
